mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sales_daily (store_id, day, sales_count, gross, discount_total, tax_total) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{day}, 1, #{gross}, #{discount}, #{tax}) ON CONFLICT (store_id, day) DO UPDATE SET sales_count = sales_daily.sales_count + 1, gross = sales_daily.gross + EXCLUDED.gross, discount_total = sales_daily.discount_total + EXCLUDED.discount_total, tax_total = sales_daily.tax_total + EXCLUDED.tax_total

INSERT INTO sales_daily (store_id, day, refund_count, refund_total) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{day}, 1, #{amount}) ON CONFLICT (store_id, day) DO UPDATE SET refund_count = sales_daily.refund_count + 1, refund_total = sales_daily.refund_total + EXCLUDED.refund_total

INSERT INTO product_daily (store_id, day, product_id, sku, name, quantity, revenue) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{day}, #{productId}, #{sku}, #{name}, #{quantity}, #{revenue}) ON CONFLICT (store_id, day, product_id) DO UPDATE SET quantity = product_daily.quantity + EXCLUDED.quantity, revenue = product_daily.revenue + EXCLUDED.revenue, sku = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.sku, product_daily.sku), name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.name, product_daily.name)

INSERT INTO cashier_daily (store_id, day, cashier_id, sales_count, gross) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{day}, #{cashierId}, 1, #{gross}) ON CONFLICT (store_id, day, cashier_id) DO UPDATE SET sales_count = cashier_daily.sales_count + 1, gross = cashier_daily.gross + EXCLUDED.gross
INSERT INTO processed_events (event_id) VALUES (#{eventId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
